'''Pruno Jant''' was a [[human]] who was a member of the [[Cloud-Riders]] rebel gang during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Pruno Jant was a human with light skin and dark-brown hair.<ref name="Solo" />

==Equipment==
Jant wore a black leathery [[Clothing|cloak]] and brown trousers and boots. On their [[belt]] were various devices, aswell as a chain of [[bone]]s. They concealed their head with a skull mask and a brown scarf. They wielded a model of [[blaster carbine]].<ref name="Card Trader">{{SWCT|set=The Cloud-Riders|cardname=Pruno Jant}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pruno Jant first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was later identified by name in the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' app.<ref name="Card Trader" />
